items.name: Allow standby states
items.description: Allow standby states controls sleep/standby and wake orchestration.
items.shortDescription: Allow standby states controls sleep/standby and wake orchestration.
items.longDescription: Adjusts allow standby states through sleep/standby and wake orchestration. Performance-oriented values reduce ramp delays but increase draw and heat.
items.whatItDoes: Writes and tracks allow standby states so Falcon can apply, verify, and rollback consistently for this policy family.
items.whyGamersCare: It is mostly a power-behavior control and usually has limited direct gaming benefit.
items.fpsImpact: Average FPS impact is generally minimal.
items.latencyImpact: Direct end-to-end latency impact is usually low.
items.powerImpact: Conservative values favor lower power at the cost of responsiveness.
items.heatImpact: Thermal impact is usually modest unless combined with other aggressive settings.
items.stabilityRisk: Medium when changed without hardware-specific validation.
items.recommendedFor: Only for controlled experiments with rollback ready.
items.avoidIf: Avoid if you cannot benchmark changes or need strict OEM-default behavior.
items.warningText: Can break startup, resume, or hibernate behavior on some systems.
riskNotes: Can break startup, resume, hibernate, or wake paths and may force recovery mode.
items.rollbackNotes: Rollback immediately if boot/resume issues appear.
